fields.name: goal_target
fields.description: The single target position, in [y, x], on which the goal-named cube (the colour named in the goal instruction) is to be dropped. Written at step #1, the only step that shows the demonstration, and copied unchanged at every later step; unknown before the demonstration has been seen. To fill it, list every release of the goal-named cube in the demonstration in ascending frame time: a release is a frame where the fingers go from a partly closed value (~46%) to ~100% open while the goal-named cube was marked 'held in the gripper' in the frames just before, and its entry is the target closest to the cube's resting spot in the frames right after that release, with the target's position taken from a frame where all four targets are listed (e.g. the last demo frame). Exclude the last release of the demonstration, which sets the cube down near the image centre around [82, 127] where no target lies; exclude button presses (fingers 0% open, no cube held); do not treat a frame where the cube merely loses its 'held' label while the gripper is raised as a release. Number the remaining releases earliest first and take the entry the goal's ordinal names ('first' = 1, 'second' = 2, 'third' = 3, 'fourth' = 4). e.g. [107, 86]
